witness.text: Experienced frontend engineer focused on internal developer console development, test suite ownership, API coordination, and release documentation.
Developed and maintained pipeline and artifact views using TypeScript and React, including a virtualised log viewer that replaced full-page log rendering.
Owned component test suite (React Testing Library) and end-to-end suite (Playwright), adding a smoke run to the CI pipeline that blocks releases on failures.
Coordinated API changes with backend team through design reviews, adapting console views to approved endpoint changes.
Authored release notes documenting known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each console release.
Managed console view development, test‑suite ownership, API coordination, and release documentation over approximately two years.
Playwright end‑to‑end suite for the pipeline view and release notes for a console release, with CI pipeline run identifiers as verification trail.
